title: Delhi Schools Add Idli-Sambar to PM-POSHAN Menu

blocks.content: Delhi’s Directorate of Education (DoE) revised the PM-POSHAN menu for government and government-aided schools in New Delhi on 11 August 2026. The updated midday meal plan includes idli-sambar, along with changes in several weekly dishes under the school nutrition scheme.

items: PM-POSHAN is a school nutrition programme implemented in government and government-aided schools.
Idli is a steamed rice-based dish from South India, and sambar is a lentil-based vegetable stew.
Millets such as jowar and bajra are coarse grains used in Indian diets and public nutrition programmes.
Delhi’s school meal menu changes were reviewed by a dedicated meal review committee.
